en.summary: Itchy hives without breathing/swallowing trouble are often managed with clinician/pharmacist advice. Any sudden airway swelling, severe breathing difficulty, collapse → treat as anaphylaxis emergency (see anaphylaxis entry). Antihistamines are not first-line for severe anaphylaxis (HAS message).
emergencyIf: Sudden lip/tongue/throat swelling, severe wheeze/gasping, collapse, confusion — anaphylaxis pathway
seeDoctorIf: Hives affecting daily life, widespread, persistent, or uncertain trigger
selfCare: Pharmacist advice on non-drowsy antihistamines when appropriate — follow label
doNot: Do not treat possible anaphylaxis with antihistamines alone

fr.summary: Urticaire sans gêne respiratoire : souvent conseil pharmacien/médecin. Gonflement des voies aériennes / détresse = anaphylaxie. Les antihistaminiques ne sont pas le 1er traitement de l'anaphylaxie (HAS).
emergencyIf: Gonflement lèvres/gorge, dyspnée sévère, malaise — voie anaphylaxie

he.summary: סרפדת ללא קושי נשימה — לרוב ייעוץ רוקח/רופא. נפיחות נתיב אוויר / מצוקה = אנפילקסיס. אנטי־היסטמינים אינם קו ראשון באנפילקסיס.

ru.summary: Крапивница без дыхательных проблем — обычно совет фармацевта/врача. Отёк дыхательных путей / тяжёлая одышка = анафилаксия. Антигистамины не первая линия при анафилаксии.
